premises.text: Women have no guide for whether hormonal changes are expected, normal, or abnormal
premises.evidence_span: Who's there to tell us if a change is expected, normal, or abnormal? Today, no one

premises.text: Hormones must be tested on specific days because they fluctuate constantly through the month
premises.evidence_span: they change and they fluctuate constantly throughout the month. They need to be tested on specific days

premises.text: Lab blood testing is slow and costly for discovering individual hormone levels across a cycle
premises.evidence_span: not a convenient or cost efficient solution as you need multiple blood tests per cycle

premises.text: Hormona's urine test and app give quantitative at-home results in 15 minutes without a lab and at lower cost
premises.evidence_span: decreased the time it takes for you to get your test results from five days to 15 minutes, and also offering a five times cheaper product

premises.text: Three key female hormones plus a cycle algorithm and app analysis reveal each woman's hormone pattern and symptom links
premises.evidence_span: The three quantitative test results per cycle allows women to see their unique hormone pattern

value.text: Better predictions and earlier detection of overlooked hormonal issues through regular monitoring
value.evidence_span: Regular testing and monitoring of these key hormones will enable better predictions and earlier detections

secondary_value.evidence_span: understand their hormones from the comfort of our home
